product_metadata.title: Etekcity Food Kitchen Bowl Scale, Digital Ounces and Grams for Cooking, Baking, Meal Prep, Dieting, and Weight Loss, Large, Silver
features: Precise measurement: weigh up to 11 lb; graduation: 0. 1 oz/; minimum weight recommendation: 3 g; 10 inches diameter of the bowls can hold 27 oz; Battery included

Multifunctional: measure and quickly convert units between lb. (Oz. ), G, mL, and fl. Oz. Include water and milk volume measurement modes with refined accuracy; high range of applications including food, ingredients, milk, grains, button, drugs, chemicals and more
Easy Tare: features tare and auto-zero functions for easy compatibility with other containers; measure in a mug, plate, or different sized bowl with dependable and hassle-free accuracy
Practical design: Detachable bowl design, free mix ingredients, easy storage in small size, be used as a space saving protective cover and directly measure without the bowl
description: With a weight capacity of 11 pounds (5 kilograms) and graduation of 0.1 ounces (1 gram), this Etekcity digital kitchen scale has the accuracy to meet your personal and commercial needs.The compact and lightweight design makes it ideal for homes, kitchens, offices, mailrooms, and more. The scale clearly displays measurement results in kg(g), lb(oz), fl oz, and ml on the digital LCD display the instant any weight is applied

The digital scale was designed with a removable bowl, great for measuring mixed ingredients and tare measurements. When not in use, the bowl can be flipped upside down and placed over the scale unit to be used as a protective case, making it easy to store without taking up too much space.

Save energy and save time. The auto-zero and tare functions are featured for accuracy when weighing items individually or in containers. After 2 minutes of inactivity, the digital scale will trigger the auto-off function, prolonging the battery lifespan. It also provides low battery and overload indications. Save energy and simplify your life without lifting a finger.
